arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, getcontext
getcontext().prec=50
rows='''SUP-001,164,56.53,781
SUP-002,324,137.19,441
SUP-003,168,99.98,799
SUP-004,217,83.66,454
SUP-005,363,124.67,189
SUP-006,233,17.23,154
SUP-007,64,57.17,700
SUP-008,373,134.81,599
SUP-009,61,82.1,154
SUP-010,266,93.01,518'''.splitlines()
x=Decimal('1.1379'); duty=Decimal('0.0427')
tot=Decimal('0')
for line in rows:
 id,q,p,f=line.split(',')
 base=Decimal(q)*Decimal(p)+Decimal(f)
 raw=base*x*(1+duty)
 amt=raw.quantize(Decimal('0.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 tot+=amt
 print(id, 'base',base,'raw',raw,'rounded',amt)
print('records',len(rows),'total',tot)
print('unrounded aggregate',sum((Decimal(l.split(',')[1])*Decimal(l.split(',')[2])+Decimal(l.split(',')[3]))*x*(1+duty) for l in rows))
PY"}
